TEMPORARY SERVICE INTERRUPTION
We're Currently Conducting Emergency Maintenance
In response to a global cybersecurity vulnerability, some Memorial University websites and online services have been temporarily taken offline as a precautionary measure to allow emergency maintenance and proactive security updates to be completed.
Technical staff are actively working to restore service as quickly and safely as possible.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
